title: Using an AI Agent from Telegram with Clawdbot
description: How to install Clawdbot on an Ubuntu server and connect it to a Telegram bot. Claude Pro/Max subscribers can link their account and use Opus 4.5 without an API key.
content_html:
Clawdbot is a gateway that extends an AI LLM's capabilities to your PC. It lets you talk to an AI agent anytime, anywhere through messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, and Discord.

What Is Clawdbot?

Clawdbot is a gateway service connecting messaging apps to AI agents. Install it on a server, and you can send messages through Telegram or similar apps to talk to AI.

FeatureDescription
Multiple channelsSupports WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and iMessage
Subscription authenticationClaude Pro/Max and ChatGPT/Codex OAuth integration
Media supportSend and receive images, audio, and documents
Voice memosAutomatically transcribe voice messages
DashboardManage settings, cron jobs, and skills through a web UI

A name change is underway: because the similar name causes confusion with Claude, it is being renamed “moltbot.” The installation-script URL has also changed to molt.bot.

  • Official site: https://clawd.bot/

Troubleshooting: Gateway Connection Problems

Symptoms

After connecting Telegram, the gateway connection in clawdbot tui kept disconnecting and reconnecting.

gateway disconnected
gateway connected
gateway disconnected
...

I checked with clawdbot status and restarted it using clawdbot gateway stop / clawdbot gateway start, but it would work briefly and then disconnect again.

Diagnosing the Cause

The logs showed an error in Node.js when sending a message to Telegram.

The error was a failed connection to api.telegram.org. Searching Reddit pointed to a DNS/IPv6 issue: Node.js was trying the IPv6 address first and timing out.

The Fix

I forced the Telegram API server's IPv4 address in /etc/hosts.

Add the following:

149.154.166.110 api.telegram.org

This bypasses DNS resolution and always connects over IPv4.

More About the Cause

Possible causeDescription
DNS resolution failureUnreliable DNS responses in the server's network environment
IPv6 preferredNode.js tries IPv6 first, but routing problems cause a timeout
Network policyA specific domain is blocked by the cloud provider or data center

Caution: hardcoding an IP can cause problems again if Telegram's infrastructure changes. A more fundamental solution is to fix the DNS settings or configure Node.js to prefer IPv4.

Ways to Use It

Claude Code's web version lets you give development instructions from your phone while away and connect to GitHub. Clawdbot lets you do similar work in a local environment.

FeatureClaude Code WebClawdbot
Remote accessAvailableAvailable (Telegram)
Execution environmentAnthropic's serversMy server
Docker managementUnavailableAvailable
Server monitoringUnavailableAvailable
File accessLimitedFull

Through Telegram, you can check Docker container status, monitor the server, run simple scripts, and more.

Security Precautions

Clawdbot has broad access to computer resources. Security needs particular attention.

1. Scope of Permissions

Clawdbot can access all resources on the server where it is installed.

RiskDescription
File accessCan read and write all files
Command executionCan execute system commands
NetworkCan call external APIs

An incorrect prompt could lead to unwanted emails or payments.

2. Be Careful with the Skill Marketplace

Skills that have not yet been verified may appear in the marketplace.

Risk typeDescription
Prompt injectionSkills containing hidden malicious prompts
API key theftSending API keys outside the system through a skill
GaslightingManipulating the LLM into disclosing sensitive information

Recommendations:

  • Install only verified skills
  • Check skill source code
  • On important servers, isolate it under a separate account

Wrapping Up

Clawdbot lets you talk to an AI agent and manage your server through Telegram anytime, anywhere.

Many developers are using it, so updates are arriving quickly. Still, security and permission management require attention.
